title: WSS guide: fallback guidance skips EventSource/SSE as primary non-WebSocket path
description: The capabilities section says to fall back to 'HTTP polling and PushSubscription-based push' when WebSocket is unavailable. EventSource (SSE) is the primary non-WebSocket real-time path already defined in the JMAP Chat spec. HTTP polling is a last resort. Skipping SSE steers implementers toward a worse path. The fallback guidance should list SSE first, then PushSubscription for background/mobile, then polling only as a last resort.
